desc: The Radians T-85™ is an interchangeable 5 lens kit. The glass has a sleek lightweight design with adjustable temples, rubber nosepiece and rubber temple pads. One piece interchangeable lens design allows a wearer to easily switch lenses for different lighting situations. Includes neoprene carrying case, neck cord, and microfiber lens cloth bag. Exceeds ANSI Z87.1+ Standards.
